issue.title: records tidy member about and group long help omit redundant-H1 removal
issue.description: Proposed by bob-cli-o6.3 (note #2, PROPOSED FOLLOW-UP) and triaged by the bob-cli-o6 land agent. src/runner.rs RECORDS_MEMBERS 'tidy' about says 'Remove empty `## Notes` sections from Record Notes' while the clap about (and docs/records.md) also cover redundant-H1 removal; the bob records group long help likewise says only 'tidy removes empty ## Notes sections'. Pre-existing from the records-tidy epic (bob-cli-ms), not caused by bob-cli-o6. Align both strings with the clap about per cli_rules.md.

task_type_fields.impact: Catalog and group help under-describe what tidy rewrites, so a user consenting from that text does not expect H1 deletions
task_type_fields.location: src/runner.rs RECORDS_MEMBERS 'tidy' about and the bob records group long help
task_type_fields.repro: Compare 'bob records --help' / the runner catalog entry with 'bob records tidy --help' and docs/records.md: only the latter two mention redundant-H1 removal

issue.creation_reason: bob-cli-o6.3 note #2 found the catalog about text stale next to the clap about and docs; filed by the bob-cli-o6 land agent to realign the three descriptions.
